attchmntText: Agro Phos India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Agro Phos India Limited submitted the newspaper publication of financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on 07th November 2026. The results were published in Free Press and Choutha Sansar on the same date. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the exchange to acknowledge the submission. The document includes a letter from Company Secretary Reena S. signed on 07th November 2026. It also contains unrelated news articles regarding US politics and a Hindi text section discussing various topics. The core action is the regulatory submission of financial results publication.

attchmntText: Agro Phos India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
